calculation_handling.description: The short-term bicycle parking requirement may be reduced by up to half, rounded down.
calculation_handling.gaps: No target exists for a reduction in required spaces.

units.disclosure: A payment-in-lieu reduction of up to half the required short-term bicycle parking is not modelled.

calculation_handling.description: Each short-term space reduced requires a payment in lieu to the City.
calculation_handling.gaps: Payment amounts and the City's rate are not held.

units.disclosure: The payment owed to the City for each reduced short-term bicycle space is not modelled.

calculation_handling.description: A reduction needs an agreement with the City under Section 40 of the Planning Act.
calculation_handling.gaps: Agreements are a process step, not lot data.

units.disclosure: The required agreement with the City under Section 40 of the Planning Act is not modelled.

970.30.15.5(5).explanation: The required short-term bicycle parking may be reduced by up to half (rounded down) if the owner pays the City a payment in lieu for each reduced space and signs a Planning Act Section 40 agreement.
